name: use-case-explorer
title: Use Case Explorer
description: An interactive marketing section that lets visitors choose a role or scenario and see the relevant description and outcomes. It accepts a title and cases with stable ids, labels, headings, descriptions, and outcome lists. Use it to help different audiences recognize how the same product fits their workflow; use Product Spotlight when the distinction is between product capabilities instead of user groups.

meta.engineeringNotes: Uses an explicit audience selector and a single associated content panel instead of rendering every persona as a separate long card. This makes the audience choice the organizing action and keeps each benefit list tied to its intended visitor. Native buttons and aria-pressed avoid a bespoke tab system while preserving standard keyboard activation.
meta.motionNotes: Changing audience replaces the panel content immediately with no slide or fade, preventing motion from obscuring the newly selected audience's message. A visible pressed state and clear labels communicate selection. Reduced-motion settings require no behavior change because the interaction has no animation.

docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Provide short labels and outcome copy for each audience; all case content is local and available without a network request.
